nodes.description: Immutable address of the token distributed by the contract (token).
Immutable merkle root of the tree containing claimable account balances (merkleRoot).
Packed mapping(uint256=>uint256) bit map tracking which claim indexes have already been claimed.
MerkleDistributor constructor; assigns immutable token and merkleRoot from arguments.
isClaimed(uint256 index): computes word/bit index, masks the bit map and returns whether the bit is set.
_setClaimed(uint256 index) private: sets the bit corresponding to index in claimedBitMap.
claim(index, account, amount, merkleProof) external: checks not claimed, verifies merkle proof, marks claimed and transfers tokens.
MerkleProof.verify(proof, root, leaf): recomputes the root by sorted-pair hashing and compares with root.
IERC20.transfer(recipient, amount) external interface: token transfer entry point invoked by claim.
External call IERC20(token).transfer(account, amount) executed inside claim after state update.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(index, account, amount)) leaf hash construction in claim.
claim parameter index: leaf index/identifier of the claim.
claim parameter account: recipient of the distributed tokens.
claim parameter amount: token amount to transfer.
claim parameter merkleProof: sibling hashes proving the leaf.
Local bytes32 node holding the computed leaf hash in claim.
Local uint256 claimedWordIndex = index / 256 in isClaimed/_setClaimed.
Local uint256 claimedBitIndex = index % 256 in isClaimed/_setClaimed.

edges.reason: claim calls isClaimed(index) in a require to reject already claimed drops.
claim's index parameter is forwarded as the argument to isClaimed.
index is packed into the merkle leaf hash.
account is packed into the merkle leaf hash.
amount is packed into the merkle leaf hash.
The keccak256 result is stored in the local node variable.
Local leaf hash node is passed to MerkleProof.verify.
Caller-supplied merkleProof array is passed to MerkleProof.verify.
Stored merkleRoot is used as the trusted root in MerkleProof.verify.
The boolean returned by MerkleProof.verify gates execution of the rest of claim via require.
claim calls the private _setClaimed(index) to record the claim.
claim's index parameter is passed into _setClaimed.
_setClaimed performs shift and bitwise-OR arithmetic on the packed bit map word.
The computed bit mask is written back into claimedBitMap[claimedWordIndex].
isClaimed reads the packed word from claimedBitMap.
Local claimedWordIndex is used to index the claimedBitMap mapping.
isClaimed derives local claimedWordIndex from index.
isClaimed derives local claimedBitIndex from index and uses it in the mask.
claim performs the external token transfer after marking the claim; the token call can reenter the contract.
Stored immutable token address is the target of the external transfer call.
account parameter is the recipient argument of the external transfer.
amount parameter is the value argument of the external transfer.
The external call invokes IERC20.transfer on the token contract, handing control to external code.
Constructor writes the token_ argument into the immutable token state variable.
Constructor writes the merkleRoot_ argument into the immutable merkleRoot state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: index is only meaningful as an argument of claim; fold it into the claim function node.
account is only used as the transfer recipient inside claim; fold it into the claim function node.
merkleProof is consumed solely by MerkleProof.verify; fold it into the verify function node.
The local node hash is a temporary result of the leaf hashing operation; fold it into the keccak256 leaf node.
claimedWordIndex is a temporary derived value inside isClaimed; fold it into the isClaimed function node.
claimedBitIndex is a temporary derived value inside isClaimed; fold it into the isClaimed function node.
